concepts.title: Harbor (CursorAuto)
concepts.design_contract_summary: Berthing IA: pier-desk search, berth destinations, split pier workspace with slip scrollspy; Providers + Memory + Terminal; LSP full checklist on open.

impacts.requirement: Nine unambiguous row states; no empty field meaning Auto/Inherit/Not configured.
impacts.selected_concept_behavior: Rows render explicit state badges and value-source lines; blanks only for literal empty or active optional entry.
slint_notes: row is a data-driven widget; no DOM measurement for state
notes: Recorded only; nothing applied to canon.

impacts.requirement: Home destinations are places, not filter pills; workspace jump + scrollspy.
impacts.selected_concept_behavior: Berth cards open a full workspace; slips jump; scrollspy updates active slip from section registry.

impacts.requirement: Assistant memory Gists: verified/awaiting-review, evidence, pin, half-life fade, versions/repair, access history.
impacts.selected_concept_behavior: Memory drydock exposes these controls with simulated receipts; Preference Gists Assistant-only.
notes: Half-life language is fades from active context, never expires.

concepts.title: Score (CursorAuto)
concepts.design_contract_summary: Continuous score IA: cue search, movement plates, rehearsal-mark scrollspy; Providers + Personas + MCP.

impacts.requirement: Persona is behavior, not account/model/permission/budget authority; scopes and child-only exclusion.
impacts.selected_concept_behavior: Persona appendix separates definition/runtime/capsule; scopes explicit; child-only excluded from Chat defaults.

impacts.requirement: MCP manager with progressive tool exposure and approval durations without becoming an approval log.
impacts.selected_concept_behavior: MCP appendix shows transport, protocol negotiated, lazy tools, approval policy select, reconnect/logs simulated.

concepts.title: Switchboard (CursorAuto)
concepts.design_contract_summary: Operator patch-bay IA: docked search, jack destinations, patch-sheet workspace; Providers + Context & Instructions + Skills/Plugins/Tools.

impacts.requirement: Context & Instructions manager: durable breadth, narrow turn context; admit/omit diagnostics.
impacts.selected_concept_behavior: Context patch bay shows normal toggles plus last-turn admitted/omitted matrix with provenance.

impacts.requirement: Skills, plugins, tools, commands remain distinct with progressive disclosure.
impacts.selected_concept_behavior: Unified skills patch bay keeps separate sections and trust/enable/project-enabled states.

concepts.title: Archive (CursorAuto)
concepts.design_contract_summary: Archival retrieval IA: finding-aid search, collection guides, outline+document workspace; Providers + Crew + Media.

impacts.requirement: Crew is Orchestrator-owned composition; requested vs effective members/waves; thread/Goal local.
impacts.selected_concept_behavior: Crew collection shows templates with name/purpose, Persona per role, guards, and requested vs effective capacity.

impacts.requirement: Media providers need connection/account/model rigor plus routes, modalities, safety, cost, history.
impacts.selected_concept_behavior: Media collection mirrors provider rigor for image/audio/video routes without copying Open Design visuals.

cross_concept_findings: All four replace bloom/category pills with destinations-as-places and full workspace + managers.
Provider hierarchy, CLI-owned OAuth for Claude/Antigravity, Free Models grouping, and Usage snapshot ownership are shared.
Spellcheck Normal/Advanced options and no-autocorrect contract are shared via Appearance Input + demo spell service.
LSP has no featured sibling pair; Harbor implements the full LSP checklist when opened so the portfolio still proves the manager language.
